svg.title: Step 9 mockup 04: a Saturday on the Main screen
svg.text: 04 · A Saturday on the Main screen: what the feeds change, hour by hour
Four moments of the demo event. Nothing is scheduled by hand for them: the agenda, the feeds, Moments' stories and one night scene decide.
Use case: attendees in the hall; the organiser sees what the defaults do.
14:10 · Doors open

g.text: Check in with your phone: scan

svg.text: Notify: the rotating check-in code
Bot: Right now climbs ▲, checked in counts
Agenda and tournament: the first heat, next
Games are counted from the first player
18:20 · Dinner
Pizza (step 5): the last-call story and the box
Bot: the evening peak, 248 at 18:40
Now playing re-sorts as people stop for food
Nothing new for step 9 to build here
19:45 · Heat called
Tournament: match called (Moments), standings
Bot: the voice room's name, the room fills
A result: rows slide, ▲1 for 60 s
The ticker stays the crew's
01:30 · Night
A night scene switches the zone to the LAN board
History: the day's graph, tonight's top games
Calm: numbers roll, no celebrations
Quiet hours still win over it
Same pace all day (amendment 1): the hero's dwell never changes; only the effects grow with the energy level.
